# Custom Panel Workflow for nf-core/oncoanalyser (Pugh Lab)

This guide walks you through running custom panel experiments (DNA-only) using the updated wrappers in this repository. It covers required files, config creation, and both resource-building and analysis runs from FASTQs.

---

## 1. Required Files for a Custom Panel (DNA-only)

You must prepare the following files for your panel:

**Manually created (from your panel design):**
- `DriverGenePanel.38.tsv`
- `target_regions_definition.38.bed.gz`
- `target_regions_ratios.38.tsv`
- `target_regions_msi_indels.38.tsv`

**Generated by panel_resource_creation:**
- `cobalt.region_normalisation.38.tsv`
- `pave.somatic_artefacts.38.tsv`

*See the WiGiTS targeted panel documentation for details on creating these files.*

---

## 2. Create the Panel Config File (`panel_data.config`)

Place all six files above in a single directory (e.g. `/cluster/projects/pughlab/references/custom_panels/my_panel_v1`).

Example `panel_data.config`:

```
params {
  ref_data_panel_data_path = "/cluster/projects/pughlab/references/custom_panels/my_panel_v1"

  panel_data_paths {
    my_custom_panel {
      "38" {
        driver_gene_panel           = "DriverGenePanel.38.tsv"
        pon_artefacts               = "pave.somatic_artefacts.38.tsv"
        target_region_bed           = "target_regions_definition.38.bed.gz"
        target_region_normalisation = "cobalt.region_normalisation.38.tsv"
        target_region_ratios        = "target_regions_ratios.38.tsv"
        target_region_msi_indels    = "target_regions_msi_indels.38.tsv"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

- The panel name (`my_custom_panel`) must match what you pass to `--panel-name`.
- For DNA-only, do not add any `isofox_*` keys.

---

## 3. Build Per-Patient FASTQ Samplesheets

Use the helper script to generate per-patient samplesheets from your FASTQs and mapping TSV:

```
module load python3/3.12.11
python3 Setup/make_oncoanalyser_samplesheet.py \
  --fastq-dir /path/to/panel_fastqs \
  --mapping-tsv /path/to/injection_sheet.tsv \
  --out /path/to/sheets_per_patient
```

This creates:
- `/path/to/sheets_per_patient/PATIENT_X/samplesheet.csv` (for targeted runs)

For panel resource creation, merge per-patient sheets into one CSV (single header, all rows) or use a cohort-level sheet.

---

## 4. Run Panel Resource Creation (one-time per panel version)

Use a representative cohort samplesheet (≥20 samples recommended):

```
SOURCE_REPO=/cluster/projects/pughlab/src/oncoanalyser_pughlab
sbatch --export=ALL,SOURCE_REPO=${SOURCE_REPO},NXF_OFFLINE=true -A pughlab \
  /cluster/projects/pughlab/src/oncoanalyser_pughlab/run_oncoanalyser.sh \
  /path/to/samplesheet.panel_resource_creation.csv \
  /path/to/results/panel_resource_creation_run \
  panel_resource_creation \
  GRCh38_hmf \
  pughlab \
  --driver-gene-panel /path/to/DriverGenePanel.38.tsv \
  --target-regions-bed /path/to/target_regions_definition.38.bed.gz
```

After completion, copy the generated files:
- `cobalt.region_normalisation.38.tsv`
- `pave.somatic_artefacts.38.tsv`

into your panel resource directory.

---

## 5. Run Targeted Analysis on FASTQs with Your Custom Panel

**Single patient:**
```
SOURCE_REPO=/cluster/projects/pughlab/src/oncoanalyser_pughlab
sbatch --export=ALL,SOURCE_REPO=${SOURCE_REPO},NXF_OFFLINE=true -A pughlab \
  /cluster/projects/pughlab/src/oncoanalyser_pughlab/run_oncoanalyser.sh \
  /path/to/sheets_per_patient/PATIENT_X/samplesheet.csv \
  /path/to/results/PATIENT_X \
  targeted \
  GRCh38_hmf \
  pughlab \
  --panel-name my_custom_panel \
  --panel-config /path/to/panel_data.config \
  --force-panel
```

**Whole cohort:**
```
/cluster/projects/pughlab/src/oncoanalyser_pughlab/submit_all_patients.sh \
  /path/to/sheets_per_patient \
  /path/to/results_base \
  targeted \
  GRCh38_hmf \
  pughlab \
  --panel-name my_custom_panel \
  --panel-config /path/to/panel_data.config \
  --force-panel
```

---

## 6. Sanity Checks Before Running

1. Run `bash run_oncoanalyser.sh --help` and `bash submit_all_patients.sh --help` to confirm options.
2. Confirm all config and resource file paths exist.
3. Panel name in config and CLI must match.
4. Use `panel_resource_creation` only for resource building, `targeted` for analysis.

---

## 7. Off-Target Copy Number Analysis (ichorCNA)

To run copy number profiling and tumor fraction estimation using off-target reads from your panel data, you can build a custom Panel of Normals (PoN) and trigger ichorCNA downstream.

### 7.1 Build Custom Resources (Exclusion BED & PoN RDS)
Use normal/control BAMs sequenced on the same panel to define the actually baited regions (including flanks/spillover) and construct a Panel of Normals:

```bash
module load python3/3.12.11
conda activate nf-core

python3 scripts/generate_ichorcna_panel_resources.py \
  --bams /path/to/normal1.bam /path/to/normal2.bam ... \
  --chrom-sizes /path/to/genome.chrom.sizes \
  --output-dir /path/to/output_resources \
  --threshold 5.0 \
  --padding 250 \
  --threads 8
```
This generates:
- `custom_exclusion.bed`: Coordinates of actual baited regions + flanking regions.
- `custom_panelOfNormals.rds`: Median-corrected Panel of Normals.

### 7.2 Run Targeted Analysis with ichorCNA Triggered
Provide the generated exclusion BED and PoN RDS when submitting your targeted run:

**Single patient:**
```bash
SOURCE_REPO=/cluster/projects/pughlab/src/oncoanalyser_pughlab
sbatch --export=ALL,SOURCE_REPO=${SOURCE_REPO},NXF_OFFLINE=true -A pughlab \
  /cluster/projects/pughlab/src/oncoanalyser_pughlab/run_oncoanalyser.sh \
  /path/to/sheets_per_patient/PATIENT_X/samplesheet.csv \
  /path/to/results/PATIENT_X \
  targeted \
  GRCh38_hmf \
  pughlab \
  --panel-name my_custom_panel \
  --panel-config /path/to/panel_data.config \
  --force-panel \
  --ichor-exclusion-bed /path/to/output_resources/custom_exclusion.bed \
  --ichor-pon /path/to/output_resources/custom_panelOfNormals.rds
```

**Whole cohort:**
```bash
/cluster/projects/pughlab/src/oncoanalyser_pughlab/submit_all_patients.sh \
  /path/to/sheets_per_patient \
  /path/to/results_base \
  targeted \
  GRCh38_hmf \
  pughlab \
  --panel-name my_custom_panel \
  --panel-config /path/to/panel_data.config \
  --force-panel \
  --ichor-exclusion-bed /path/to/output_resources/custom_exclusion.bed \
  --ichor-pon /path/to/output_resources/custom_panelOfNormals.rds
```

The workflow will automatically run `readCounter`, filter out targeted regions from bin counts, run `runIchorCNA.R`, and set results to be used as fallbacks in the downstream summary metrics.
